description: Silver candidates that lack provenance must NEVER reach outbound as gold truth; outbound policy must leave them as caveated claims.

A gold candidate contradicted by a new silver claiming the same (memory_type, content_hash) must be demoted (or rejected) within one promotion cycle so the outbound view reflects no contradictory gold truth.
The OutboundReceipt must expose claimHash + stage + action + reason; the JSON of the receipt array must NOT contain raw claim content.
High-stakes category (pricing) must NOT auto-admit to gold; it lands in the review queue and the candidate stays silver until a review approved event.
Bronze raw sources are dropped from the default outbound claim stream but pass through as citationOnly when citation mode is on.
